params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.device_registry
params.description: Required. The new values for the device registry. The id field must be empty, and the name field must indicate the path of the resource. For example, projects/example-project/locations/us-central1/registries/my-registry.

params.name: data.update_mask
params.description: Required. Only updates the device_registry fields indicated by this mask. The field mask must not be empty, and it must not contain fields that are immutable or only set by the server. Mutable top-level fields: event_notification_config, http_config, mqtt_config, and state_notification_config.
